name: Groq Simple Chat with Knowledge Base (ready-made nodes)

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Get a free Groq API key: https://console.groq.com/keys
2. Open the **Groq Chat Model** node and create a new **Groq API** credential with that key (click the credential dropdown → Create New).
3. Open the **Knowledge Base** node and replace the placeholder text with your own markdown (FAQ, policy doc, whatever you want the bot grounded on).
4. Click **Chat** at the bottom of the canvas to test.

This version uses n8n's ready-made LangChain nodes (Basic LLM Chain + Groq Chat Model) instead of a hand-built HTTP Request — no manual JSON body, headers, or response parsing. See workflows/groq-simple-chat.json for the hand-built version that shows what's happening under the hood.

Support is available Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00 WIB. Outside these hours, tickets are queued and answered the next business day.
